data.one_liner: Flutter volume control plugin to get, set, and monitor device volume on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to get the current device volume, set volume levels, monitor volume changes via a stream, and show or hide the system volume UI/icon.
use_when: You need to programmatically control media or device volume.
You want to listen to volume changes made by the physical hardware buttons.
You need to hide the default system volume icon or UI overlay.
avoid_when: You are testing features exclusively on an emulator, as some volume functions require a real device.
You are building full-featured media playback interfaces that rely on dedicated audio players rather than system volume control.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Provides a stream for monitoring volume changes in real-time.
Allows hiding the system volume UI overlay.
weaknesses: Some functions do not support emulators and require real device testing.
License is unknown based on available metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires testing on real machines for full functionality; follow standard plugin integration for Android and iOS.
